title: Undecodable strings are not indexed
statement: Let $p$ be any predicate on bit strings and nonnegative integers, and let $y$ be a bit string for which the aligned pair parser fails. Then $y$ does not belong to the language consisting of encodings of pairs $(x,\operatorname{bits}(i))$ such that $p(x,i)$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: The aligned pair parser returns no parse for $y$
